Configure the planner around your vault's folders and property names.

- **Search entire vault:** enabled by default. Turn it off and choose an existing **Search folder** to include only planner notes there and in its subfolders. Folder mode avoids whole-vault enumeration.
- **Property mapping:** choose the keys used for dates, titles, threads and connections. Defaults remain `date`, `title`, `thread` and `next`. Reading, creating, editing, moving and connecting entries all use the selected keys.
- **Clear settings:** separate search scope from new note locations, with English descriptions and an explicit **Apply settings** button. Invalid folder paths, duplicate property names and reserved keys are rejected before saving.
- **Existing data stays yours:** saved creation folders and zoom are preserved on update. Notes and properties are never migrated automatically. `planner_type` stays fixed; thread notes keep `status`, `color` and `order`. Changing search scope or mapping clears session undo/redo.

Creation folders remain independent of search. Empty creation paths mean the vault root. A new note saved outside the selected search scope is saved normally, with a notice that it is hidden until the scope changes.

See the [settings guide](https://github.com/DavidHurtadoAI/just-simple-planner#settings) for defaults, types and examples.

Requires Obsidian 1.10.2 or later. Install `main.js`, `manifest.json` and `styles.css` below. GitHub Actions builds, checks, attests and publishes all three assets.
